study: BRAIN02.5: BRAIN02's learner with seven local terrain quantities added to the sensed state and sixteen inputs appended at 64..79
machine: Commodore 64 PAL; Minimal64 and VICE; a plain PRG

brain.note: layout 3 and the marker BRAIN025 make a BRAIN02 slot malformed here and a BRAIN02.5 slot malformed there; neither loads into the other
brain.weight_layout: row o at weights + o * inputs, one signed byte per input (two's complement)
brain.blank_behaviour: zero weights give every accumulator the same value; the existing first-largest tie picks output 0, IDLE. There is no follow rule behind the brain in this build.

hash_domains.behavioural: bytes 8..12, 16..17 and the weights, in slot order, SHA-256

retina.name: T1
retina.table_layout: count, then ops[n], operands a[n], k-or-b[n]
retina.inputs_0_63: R1b's, entry for entry, unchanged in meaning and in order
retina.inputs_64_79: the sixteen appended thresholds over the seven terrain quantities
retina.terrain_frame: the toward frame: h = sign(refDx), or the clone's facing when refDx is zero, from the same published block the retina reads

senses.layout: one byte per sense, the signed nibble in the low four bits (8..15 negative); senses 0..19 are BRAIN02's, unchanged

terrain_meanings.tSafeRun: columns toward the reference with support at his own floor row, before the first without
terrain_meanings.tGapW: from that first unsupported column, how many in a row lack support
terrain_meanings.tFarRun: how many supported columns in a row the far side of that gap offers
terrain_meanings.tObstH: the height in rows of the first column toward him blocked at his foot row
terrain_meanings.tObstTop: the clear rows above that block's top
terrain_meanings.tHead: the clear rows above his own head, over both his columns
terrain_meanings.tBackRoom: how many columns away from the reference are clear at his foot row

flash_colours.2: red: a lesson was refused, the ring is full

live.teach_key: T (keyboard matrix row 2, column bit 6); the toggle acts on the press edge

spawn.note: the study spawn, by the far left pillar, clear of the ladder at columns 33-34

visual.human_tony: untouched: sprites 0, 1, 3 and 4 stay light grey (15)
grammar: a lesson event outranks everything: the six-frame flash is green when one was accepted and red when one was refused
teaching: a slow cyan pulse over white, six frames of every sixteen
otherwise: white, dropping out to black for one frame in thirty-two
leaving teaching returns to white and the dropout with nothing left over
visual.determinism: a pure function of bodyFrames, teachMode and the existing flash counter; no new mutable state, no random draw, and only the clone's own two sprite colour registers are written, so nothing here reaches the senses, the brain, the body, the lesson record or a replay

profiler.unit: CPU cycles, 16-bit; the live counts include whatever interrupt work fell inside them, the pure ones (hooks, interrupts held off) do not

status_bits.3: last ack rejected: a hold in progress

lessons.entry_layout: bytes 0..13: the 27 sense nibbles, nibble i in byte i/2, the low nibble for even i, so the last nibble sits alone in byte 13 with a zero high half; byte 14: the taught absolute action in the low nibble, the predicted raw output in the high nibble
lessons.slot_rule: the lesson with sequence s is at data + (s mod capacity) * 15; unread lessons are [read_seq, write_seq)
lessons.completeness: every input, old and new, is reconstructible from the entry alone: the terrain quantities are in the block, so a replay never needs the room
drain_procedure: sum every byte of those entries modulo 65536
write ack_seq = write_seq, ack_sum = the sum, then ack_request = 1
wait one frame; read status: bit 7 accepted, else bits 1..3 say why
lessons.replay: per lesson: unpack the twenty-seven nibbles, derive the eighty inputs with the retina table, translate the taught absolute action with h of the block under the relative vocabulary, apply the rule

reference_implementation.invocation: python3 tools/brain025_ref.py replay START.slot LESSONS.bin --out FINAL.slot [--expect MACHINE.slot] [--check-predictions]
reference_implementation.note: both files together: brain025_ref.py holds the retina table, the formats and the replay; brain02_ref.py holds the rule, the forward pass, the vocabulary and the first sixty-four retina entries
reference_implementation.prediction_nibble: the high nibble of the last byte is the machine's mood-free prediction as a RAW output index, which under the reference-relative vocabulary is the relative one, while the low nibble is the taught action in ABSOLUTE terms. replay --check-predictions recomputes it per lesson and fails on disagreement

test_hooks.note: research only: the hooks run the machine's own retina, forward pass, rule and terrain probe on supplied inputs

access.observation: everything above may be read at any time; read write_seq before and after a read of the weights to know no lesson intervened

research_control.capacity: may be lowered at boot before any lesson
research_control.slot: the whole slot may be written at boot to load a saved brain

access.cognition: the terrain probe, the retina, the forward pass, the resolution, the rule and the lesson recording all run in the machine; the host never computes an input, a prediction or an action for him

observe_per_lesson: the two weight rows that changed
events: teach on/off (the key or the flag)
derived: lessons to competence on a course
aliasing (the same eighty inputs taught two actions)
how often a terrain input was the only thing that changed between two decisions
